title: CardMesh
summary: Pocket client for Meshtastic and MeshCore LoRa Mesh and MeshMonitor remotely.
description: CardMesh is a keyboard-first pocket client for Meshtastic and MeshCore LoRa mesh networks, and MeshMonitor remotely -- the first CardputerZero app for Meshtastic and MeshCore. It talks directly to Meshtastic and MeshCore over the onboard LoRa hat (one at a time -- they share the single physical radio, switched with a tap), and to MeshMonitor over REST. An icon-grid Home screen gets you into any of the three; each has its own channel picker and chat view.
